intro.headline: Services _&_ fees
intro.lede: Brand, packaging and launch work for independent food and drink makers. Every price is a real range from the last two years of projects.

courses.title: To start
courses.note: Short, fixed-fee pieces that tell us both whether the bigger work is worth doing.

services.name: Brand audit
gets: a 30-page audit of every place your brand shows up
services.bring: Your files, last year's sales by product, three people for the workshop.
services.skip: You already know what is wrong and can afford to fix it. Go straight to the identity.

services.name: Naming sprint
gets: a rationale page for each name
services.bring: A one-page brief and one person who can say yes.
services.skip: The name is not the problem. Renaming a business people already recommend costs more than it earns.

courses.title: The main work
courses.note: Where most of our year goes. Each one is led by a partner from first meeting to handover.

services.name: Identity system
services.bring: A decision-maker at four reviews, and everything you use today.
services.skip: You need it in under 6 weeks. We would have to skip the research, and you would be paying for a guess.

services.name: Packaging range
gets: structure and graphics for up to 4 products
a press check at your printer
services.bring: Dielines or samples, and your printer's specifications.
services.skip: Your identity is still changing. Packaging fixes it in place for at least one print run.

services.name: Launch website
gets: a 6 to 10 page site in your CMS
a copy edit on every page
services.bring: Final copy or a writer's time, and product photography.
services.skip: You need a shop with more than 50 products. That is a different job, and we will say who to call.

courses.title: Ongoing
courses.note: For teams that ship something every week and want the same hands on it.

services.name: Design partner
gets: up to 24 hours of design a month
services.bring: One person who collects the requests, and a shared folder.
services.skip: You have fewer than 3 requests a month. Book single pieces instead.

services.name: Guidelines upkeep
services.bring: A list of what changed since the last update.
services.skip: Fewer than 10 people touch your brand. A yearly check is enough.

sets.title: Set menus
sets.note: Totals are the sum of the courses; the time allows for the overlap we plan.

items.name: The new company
items.note: The site starts in week 7 of the identity.

foot.text: Fees are fixed once the scope is signed. Travel is billed at cost.
